text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft was asked by her classmate Air 
Messiah to run alongside her in training. 
The distances were 1600m and 2000m.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft won the opening 1600m. 
Meanwhile, reporters praised Air Messiah's 
close performance, noting how much it was 
reminiscent of her mother's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, Rhein Kraft spotted Air 
Messiah training. Working hard to redeem 
her mother's regret— her figure was 
brimming with determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah, who inherited her mother's 
feelings, is an inspiration to Line Craft. 
Seeing Air Messiah's earnest devotion 
stirred her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, she loses to Air Messiah in 
a 2000m side-by-side run. Realizing her 
resolve is still lacking, she gets fired 
up once more for the Fillies' Revue.
